# Gift.wear()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.Gift.wear`

## Signature

```python
async def wear() -> bool: ...
```

## Documentation

Bound method *wear* of [`Gift`](../../types/payments/Gift.md).

> [!NOTE]
> This works for upgraded gifts only.

Use as a shortcut for:

```python
await client.set_emoji_status(types.EmojiStatus(gift_id=123))
```

### Example

```python
await star_gift.wear()
```

### Returns

`bool`: On success, True is returned.
